verdict.rationale: Neon's Management API is explicitly versioned (base URL /api/v2, with a release OpenAPI spec at api_spec/release/v2.json). Deprecation is shown only through dated, one-off notices for MCP transports (the SSE endpoint sunsets on or after October 1, 2026; the stdio package is deprecated), not a general published policy. missing for 10: a documented, general API deprecation/versioning policy (notice periods, sunset guarantees, changelog), deprecation handling for the Management API itself, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The older HTTP+SSE endpoint (`https://mcp.neon.tech/sse`) is deprecated and will stop working on or after October 1, 2026
